_readme: Per-token LIST prices used to model a dollar figure for local Claude Code
sessions. This machine's Claude Code is SUBSCRIPTION billed, so nothing here
is money that was actually charged - it is what the same tokens would cost at
published API list prices. Rows carry costBasis:'list-price-modeled' so the
Matching order: exact id in models{}, then the LONGEST matching entry in
prefixes[]. A model that matches neither gets NO cost field - never a guess.
cacheMultipliers apply to the input rate: cache writes bill ~1.25x an input
token and cache reads ~0.1x. Claude Code is cache-heavy, so leaving these out
Owner: verify against https://www.anthropic.com/pricing (and each other
vendor's page) and bump ratesVersion when you change a number.
source: Anthropic published API list prices, per the claude-api skill table cached 2026-06-24. Non-Anthropic providers are intentionally absent until the owner fills them in.
unpricedNote: gpt-*, gemini-*, grok-* and <synthetic> have no entry here on purpose: this file only carries prices the owner has verified. Add them to models{} or prefixes[] to include those rows in the cost figures.
